title: French-Style Vietnamese Banh Mi
description: A fusion of French and Vietnamese flavors, this sandwich features a crispy baguette filled with a flavorful combination of meats and pickled vegetables.

ingredients.name: Vietnamese-style pork sausage
ingredients.notes: such as cha siu or banh mi sausage

ingredients.name: grilled pork chops
ingredients.notes: marinated in a mixture of fish sauce, lime juice, and brown sugar

ingredients.name: pickled carrots and daikon
ingredients.notes: made with a mixture of vinegar, sugar, and salt

instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Grill the pork chops until cooked through, about 5-7 minutes per side.
Slice the grilled pork chops into thin strips.
Grill the Vietnamese-style pork sausage until browned and crispy, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Slice the grilled sausage into thin rounds.
Split the baguette in half lengthwise and toast until crispy.
Spread mayonnaise on the bottom half of the baguette.
Add sliced grilled pork, grilled sausage, pickled carrots and daikon, cucumber slices, and cilantro leaves to the bottom half of the baguette.
Drizzle sriracha on top of the filling, if using.
Top with the top half of the baguette.
Note: You can also assemble the sandwich just before serving and let everyone build their own.
